sig: [[["A", "Hi everyone, quick update on the office move, since I know a lot of you have been asking."], ["A", "As you know, we were originally planning to move into the new building on Parker Street on the first of June."], ["A", "Unfortunately, the fit-out has run about three weeks behind, mainly because of a delay with the network cabling."], ["A", "So the new move date is Monday the twenty-second of June."], ["A", "Here's how it'll work. On Thursday the eighteenth, the movers will collect everything except your laptops."], ["A", "That means Friday the nineteenth will be a work-from-home day for everyone."], ["A", "Please pack your desk into the labelled crates by five p.m. on Wednesday the seventeenth. Crates will be handed out next week."], ["A", "Personal items are your responsibility, so take anything valuable home."], ["A", "Now, the new office has fewer car spaces than we have now."], ["A", "So if you were thinking of driving in on the first day, you may want to reconsider."], ["A", "Parking passes will be allocated by the facilities team, and I'll share the details closer to the date."], ["A", "Thanks for your patience, everyone."]], {"A": "F-AU"}]
